# Decoded Ops
> Independent operations and technology consultancy for print, embroidery, workwear, and promotional merchandise businesses. Plain English. No jargon. Every recommendation scored against a written brief, including my own software.

## Consultancy
- [Clarity Audit](https://decodedops.co.uk/clarity): Operational and technology audit. From £1,500. One day on site, a written plan within five working days. 3x Clarity Guarantee.
- [Deliver](https://decodedops.co.uk/deliver): Project delivery and vendor management. Pricing by turnover band; six-month minimum (three for advisory-only scope).
- [Transform](https://decodedops.co.uk/transform): Multi-workstream digital transformation. Milestone-based minimum.
- [Retained](https://decodedops.co.uk/retained): Fractional CTO / Head of Operations. Advisory, Embedded, and Programme tiers; six-month minimum.
- [Pricing](https://decodedops.co.uk/pricing): Full pricing table. Plain pricing with no hidden day rate.

## Software as evidence of capability
Decoded Ops builds production-grade software for the decorated-goods sector: artwork managers, B2B commerce platforms, and the Data App, a full operations system covering catalogue, orders, purchasing, stock, production and despatch. It started as a tool to clean supplier feeds that nothing off the shelf handled, and grew from there into a system that can run alongside your existing platform or replace it. Every build starts with a Clarity Audit; the software serves the operational need the audit identifies, never the other way round. What a build costs depends entirely on what it has to do, which is why prices appear on `/pricing` and nowhere else.

- [5 Warning Signs](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/5-warning-signs): Signs your technology is costing you.
- [Free SOP Template](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/sop-template): A free SOP template with a 7-step writing method, Process Register, and Improvement Log for decoration businesses.
- [ERP Selection Guide](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/erp-selection-playbook): A plain-English guide to ERP for decorated goods: what it is, when you need it, how to choose.
- [Six Sigma for Decorated Goods](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/six-sigma): Lean and Six Sigma applied to decoration businesses, not the factory playbook.
- [Artwork Approval Playbook](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/artwork-approval-playbook): A 5-step workflow to take artwork approval from brief to sign-off in 24 hours.
- [The Decoded Method](https://decodedops.co.uk/resources/decoded-method): A three-layer process system: Process Register, one-page SOPs, and Improvement Log.
